title: file_result
description: Outcome of a `file_push` or `file_pull`. Only an open transfer of the sending PC is updated, and each stored result is written to the audit log. For a push, `done` counts only after the file was downloaded; `rejected` and `failed` count before. A pulled file is `done` when the upload is stored; a later `file_result` for it changes nothing. A `detail` starting with `[REDDEDİLDİ]` is stored as `rejected`. Unknown transfers are ignored.

status.description: done = written (push) or uploaded (pull); rejected = refused by a rule (type not allowed, path outside the allowed folders or profiles, too large, capability off); failed = an error (download, checksum, disk, file not found).

path.description: Where the file was written (push) or read (pull).

detail.description: Reason in words, shown in the panel.
